task: Identify the steps to convert a PyTorch model to TensorFlow using the Hugging Face Transformers library as described in their documentation.
answer: Per the Hugging Face Transformers documentation ('How to convert a 🤗 Transformers model to TensorFlow?', https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/add_tensorflow_model), the steps to convert a PyTorch model to TensorFlow are: 1) Log in to your Hugging Face account with `huggingface-cli login`; 2) Run the conversion CLI tool `transformers-cli pt-to-tf --model-name foo/bar` (replace foo/bar with the target model repository), which creates a PR converting the PyTorch weights to TensorFlow weights; 3) Tag @joaogante and @Rocketknight1 in the created Hub PR for review. The documentation also provides a 7-step guide for adding a TensorFlow model architecture: create the model files, implement the model, add the model to the auto-mapping, add tests, update the docs, and submit the PR.
